title: vfs game auto buy might not work in all games
features: auto buy armor chicken and tactical sg
script:
local items = {
    "[Tactical Shotgun]",
    "[Chicken]",
    "[High-Medium Armor]"
}

while true do
    for _, item in pairs(items) do
        local shop = workspace.MAP.Shops:FindFirstChild(item)
        if shop then
            local clickDetector = shop:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector")
            if clickDetector then
                fireclickdetector(clickDetector)
            end
        end
    end
    task.wait() 
end
